method: Exact allowlisted main workbook/u8 members extracted from user attachments. Full workbook inspection used Python-only limits of 250000 rows, 5000000 cells, 128 MiB per part and 256 MiB decoded/ZIP. Original captured Python plugins converted complete datasets; canonical output byte/record totals were scanned sequentially. These inspection allowances do not change native limits or qualify native conversion.
